summary: Startup founder in London (English-dominant, Turkish with family): Series A fundraising, product launch, co-founder, frequent flights, planning a wedding with an Edinburgh-born fiancee.

items.title: Company
items.text: The user is the founder and CEO of Tidemark, a London startup that automates freight invoice reconciliation for mid-sized logistics firms.

items.title: Co-founder
items.text: The user's co-founder and CTO is Dan Okafor; they met at a hackathon in 2021 and Dan holds 45% of the founders' equity.

items.title: Seed round
items.text: Tidemark closed a £1.8m seed round in March 2025, led by Marlowe Ventures.

items.title: Series A target
items.text: The user is raising a Series A of about £6m and hopes to close it by the end of January 2027.

items.title: Northfold contact
items.text: Priya Raman at Northfold Partners is the leading Series A candidate; she likes a short written update every Friday.

items.title: Cedar & Quay contact
items.text: Tom Hesketh at Cedar & Quay is a second Series A candidate; he asked for a customer concentration breakdown before meeting.

items.title: Runway
items.text: Tidemark has roughly eleven months of runway at its current burn of about £92k a month.

items.title: Team size
items.text: Tidemark has 14 employees; Marcus Bell joined as head of sales in September.

items.title: Co-working desks
items.text: The team rents hot desks at a co-working space near Old Street, and the contract renews in January.

items.title: Hackney flat
items.text: The user rents a one-bedroom flat in Hackney for £2,350 a month; the lease runs until August 2027.

items.title: Clara
items.text: The user is engaged to Clara, a veterinary nurse originally from Edinburgh.

items.title: Wedding plan
items.text: The wedding is planned for 12 June 2027 at Hawthorne Barn in Oxfordshire with about 90 guests.

items.title: İstanbul kınası
items.text: Kullanıcı düğünden sonra ailesi için İstanbul'da küçük bir kına gecesi yapmayı planlıyor; tarih Temmuz'un ilk haftası.

items.title: Annesi
items.text: Kullanıcının annesi Nermin İstanbul'un Kadıköy semtinde yaşıyor ve her pazar akşamı görüntülü arıyor.

items.title: Kız kardeşi
items.text: Kullanıcının kız kardeşi Selin Berlin'de fizik doktorası yapıyor ve tezini savunmaya hazırlanıyor.

items.title: Babası
items.text: Kullanıcının babası Cengiz emekli bir gemi makinesi mühendisi; Datça'da yaşıyor ve her çarşamba akşamı görüntülü arıyor.

items.title: Köpek Mango
items.text: Kullanıcı ve Clara'nın Mango adında beş yaşında kurtarılmış bir greyhound'u var; ikisi de seyahatteyken köpeğe bakacak biri gerekiyor.

items.title: Tırmanış
items.text: Kullanıcı haftada iki kez Hackney Wick'teki The Climbing Hangar'da boulder yapıyor ve şu an V5 problemlerini deniyor.

items.title: Frequent flyer
items.text: The user flies between London and New York roughly every six weeks and holds British Airways Silver status.

items.title: Seat habits
items.text: The user always books an aisle seat and prefers the first flight of the day, so day trips to Berlin end by the evening.

items.title: Besin alerjisi
items.text: Kullanıcının hafif bir kabuklu deniz ürünü alerjisi var; düğün menüsünde bu önemli.

items.title: Wedding budget
items.text: The couple's total wedding budget is £38,000, of which the user has set aside £25,000 from personal savings.

items.title: Northfold pitch
items.text: On 14 October the user said the Series A pitch at Northfold Partners is on Tuesday 3 November at 10:00 at their office in Mayfair.

items.title: Cedar & Quay meeting
items.text: On 16 October the user said the partner meeting with Cedar & Quay is on Thursday 5 November at 14:30 by video call.

items.title: Launch date
items.text: On 19 October the user confirmed that the Tidemark 3.0 launch is set for Tuesday 17 November, with the press embargo lifting at 08:00.

items.title: New York flight
items.text: On 8 October the user booked a flight to New York leaving Heathrow on Sunday 22 November at 11:20, returning on Thursday 26 November.

items.title: Berlin flight
items.text: On 12 October the user booked an early flight to Berlin for Monday 9 November at 06:45 for a customer workshop, returning the same evening.

items.title: Menu tasting
items.text: On 20 October the user said the menu tasting at Hawthorne Barn is on Saturday 14 November at 12:30.

items.title: Photographer call
items.text: On 21 October the user said they have a call with the wedding photographer Lena Voss on Wednesday 28 October at 18:00.

items.title: Annesinin ziyareti
items.text: 22 Ekim'de kullanıcı annesinin 6 Kasım Cuma günü İstanbul'dan Londra'ya geleceğini ve 13 Kasım'a kadar kalacağını söyledi.

items.title: Mango aşısı
items.text: 30 Eylül'de kullanıcı Mango'nun aşı randevusunun 29 Ekim Perşembe sabahı 09.00'da olduğunu söyledi.

items.title: Ev sahibi araması
items.text: 17 Ekim'de kullanıcı ev sahibinin 2 Kasım Pazartesi günü arayıp Hackney'deki kira sözleşmesinin Ağustos 2027'den sonra uzatılmasını konuşacağını söyledi.

items.title: Selin'in savunması
items.text: 25 Eylül'de kullanıcı Selin'in tez savunmasının 12 Aralık Cumartesi günü Berlin'de olacağını söyledi.

items.title: Suit fitting
items.text: On 18 October the user said the suit fitting at Penrose & Hale is on Saturday 21 November at 11:00.

items.title: Northfold data
items.text: Northfold want cohort retention by month, not by quarter. Dan is pulling the numbers tonight so I can drop them in Priya's folder.

items.title: Investment committee
items.text: Priya said their investment committee meets on Mondays, so if the pitch goes well we'd hear back on 9 November at the earliest.

items.title: Valuation floor
items.text: Honestly the real fight will be valuation. If anyone offers less than £24m post-money I think we push back, even if it slows things down.

items.title: Bank-feed matching
items.text: Tidemark 3.0 has the new bank-feed matching, and Marcus reckons it closes two enterprise deals if we ship on time.

items.title: Scope argument
items.text: Dan wants to cut multi-currency export from 3.0 and ship it in 3.1. I disagree, three customers asked for it this month.

items.title: Press plan
items.text: Sofia at the PR agency has a list of 40 journalists and wants me free for an interview on launch morning, before 10.

items.title: Venue deposit
items.text: Hawthorne Barn wants the deposit settled before December to hold the date. Clara would like to see Elmstead Manor first though.

items.title: Other venue quote
items.text: Elmstead Manor quoted £6,500 for the same Saturday, marquee hire included. Hawthorne doesn't include a marquee.

items.title: Catering needs
items.text: The caterer needs dietary requirements by mid-January. Reminder to self: Clara's mum is vegan, and I should flag my shellfish thing.

items.title: Anneye mesaj
items.text: Anne, haziranda Londra'ya gelmeyi unutma. Biletleri erken alırsak çok daha ucuz olur. Teyzem de gelebilir mi?

items.title: Kına ve izin
items.text: Annem kınadan sonra herkesin bir hafta İstanbul'da kalmasını istiyor ama ben o kadar izin alamam, en fazla dört gün.

items.title: Datça planı
items.text: Selin'e söyledim, düğünden sonra Temmuz ortasında hep birlikte Datça'ya gidelim dedi. Babam zaten orada, evi hazırlar.

items.title: Babanın takımı
items.text: Babam düğün için takım elbise diktirecekmiş, ölçüsünü Muğla'daki terziye vermiş. Ne kadar heyecanlı, inanamıyorum.

items.title: Gecikmeli uçuş
items.text: BA delayed again, 2 saattir T5'teyim. Upgrade denied, ama en azından lounge'a girebildim.

items.title: NY booking
items.text: NY için booking yaptım: koridor koltuk 24C, SoHo'da 4 gece, gecesi 289 dolar. Pahalı mı? Neyse, investor yemeği orada.

items.title: Berlin sabahı
items.text: Berlin sabahı için taksiyi 04:30'a ayarladım, alarm kuruyorum. Please don't let me oversleep.

items.title: Ev sahibi teklifi
items.text: Ev sahibi Eylülden itibaren kirayı 2.500 sterline çıkarmak istiyor. Ben 2.400 diye karşı teklif yapacağım.

items.title: Kombi tamircisi
items.text: Kombi tamircisi perşembe 8 ile 12 arası gelecek, Clara evden çalışsın. Bisikleti koridordan çekmeyi unutma.

items.title: Mango kanepe
items.text: Mango yine kanepenin köşesini kemirmiş, bu ay üçüncü kez.

items.title: Uyku ve spor
items.text: Pitch deck yüzünden bu hafta iki kez bouldering'i kaçırdım. Uyku da 5 saate düşmüş durumda.

items.title: Yeni ayakkabı
items.text: Yeni climbing shoes aldım, La Sportiva Solution, 42.5 numara. Çok dar ama açılır diyorlar.

items.title: Kahve
items.text: Bu hafta kahveyi bırakıyorum dedim ama bugün üç flat white içtim, başarısız.

items.title: Hallam Freight
items.text: Marcus Cuma günü Hallam Freight'ı kapattı, yıllık 48k pound. En iyi satış haftamız.

items.title: Backend adayı
items.text: Yarın senior backend mühendisi adayıyla görüşüyorum. Dan beğendi ama salary band 85-95k, onu doğrulamam lazım.

items.title: Ofis sorusu
items.text: Co-working sözleşmesi yaklaşıyor, daha büyük bir ofis bakmaya değer mi yoksa hybrid mi devam edelim?

items.title: Tenancy term and rent
items.text: Assured Shorthold Tenancy Agreement, Flat 3, 41 Cassland Mews, Hackney. The tenancy runs for 24 months from 1 September 2025 to 31 August 2027 at a rent of £2,350 per calendar month, payable in advance on the first of each month by standing order.

items.title: Tenancy deposit and notice
items.text: The tenant has paid a deposit of £2,710, protected in a government-approved scheme within 30 days. Either party may end the tenancy after the fixed term by giving two months' written notice.

items.title: Tenancy pets and guests
items.text: The tenant shall not keep pets without the landlord's prior written consent, which may not be unreasonably withheld. Overnight guests staying more than 21 consecutive days require the landlord's approval.

items.title: Northfold indicative terms
items.text: Northfold Partners, indicative terms (email, 9 October). Proposed investment of £6.0m for new shares at a pre-money valuation of £17.5m, which implies a post-money valuation of £23.5m. The round would be led by Northfold.

items.title: Northfold other proposals
items.text: Further proposals: a 10% unallocated option pool created before the round, one board seat for Northfold, and 45 days of exclusivity from signature of the term sheet.

items.title: Cedar & Quay indicative terms
items.text: Cedar & Quay, indicative terms (call notes, 13 October). Proposed investment of £5.5m at a pre-money valuation of £19.5m, implying £25.0m post-money. Cedar & Quay would take roughly 22% of the company.

items.title: Cedar & Quay other points
items.text: Other points discussed: a 12% option pool, a board observer seat rather than a full board seat, and 30 days of exclusivity once the term sheet is signed.

items.title: Venue hire basics
items.text: Hawthorne Barn, Venue Hire Agreement. Exclusive hire of the barn and grounds on Saturday 12 June 2027 from 14:00 to 00:00, for up to 110 guests. Bridal accommodation is available the night before.

items.title: Venue payments
items.text: Payment: a non-refundable deposit of £4,000 is due on signing and by 1 December 2026 at the latest. The balance of £9,500 is due 60 days before the event, on 13 April 2027.

items.title: Venue house rules
items.text: House rules: amplified music must end by 23:30, no confetti or sparklers indoors, and all catering must be supplied by the venue's in-house team. Final guest numbers are required 21 days before the event.
